name: Malaysia Smelting Corporation Berhad
overview: 今年公司公告主要为股息派发、股东大会及季度业绩，未披露业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长68.2%，净利润同比增长143.9%。
overview_en: This year's announcements mainly covered dividend payments, general meetings and quarterly results, with no disclosed expansion, new business, reduction or divestment of business segments. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue grew 68.2% year-on-year and net profit grew 143.9% year-on-year.
